很遺憾地改了tlg格式，TLGqoi和TLGref，立繪則是TLGmux，但不清楚以後改還是只有steam版
為什麼遺憾，因為TLGqoi裡硬寫了cg差分數量，導致遊戲沒有的cg不能像DL版pimg檔拆分差跟json去生差分圖
cglist是含有一堆遊戲沒出現的差分圖，詳見舊版cg圖庫，所以此圖庫只有遊戲可見的cg

當然我希望這是我錯，其實裡面有差分，那麼請上傳圖庫補這qhd坑

Unfortunately, they changed the TLG formats: TLGqoi and TLGref are used for CGs, while character sprites use TLGmux. It’s still unclear whether this will change again in the future, or if it’s only for the Steam version.

Why is this unfortunate? Because TLGqoi has the number of CGs hard-coded into it, which means CGs that don’t exist in the game can’t be handled the way they could in the DL version—where you could split the pimg files into diff layers and generate the variations using a JSON file.

The cglist contains a bunch of variant/diff images that never appear in the game (see the old CG gallery in the previous version for details), so this gallery includes only the CGs that are actually visible in-game.

Of course, I hope I’m wrong—and that the variant/diff layers are actually still in there. If that’s the case, then please upload the gallery and fill this QHD gap.
